text:
sam: FYI — saw a spike in routed-to-shared-pool errors. digging in, several requests had both X-Workspace and X-VPC-Endpoint headers. gateway routed to workspace. expected vpc affinity.

marta: ack. do we have a clear precedence doc? i thought VPC/private endpoints should win for isolation.

kevin: Historically gateway did: token->workspace->vpc in some codepaths (ugh). there was a migration that flipped order but not uniformly.

sam: paste of one failing request headers:

```
X-Workspace: ws_abc123
X-VPC-Endpoint: vpce-789
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
User-Agent: app/1.2.3
```

response: routed to shared workspace pool and hit cross-tenant quota.

neha: that sounds like header-hint ejection running before vpc resolution. iirc vpce lookups require an async lookup which we sometimes skip on fast-path.

jules: we should surface "routing.reason" in logs. example fields: routing.reason, routing.match, pool.id, pool.type. makes debugging easier.

marta: console UX ask: request inspector should show exact routing decision and the fallback chain. support often asks "why wasn't this request routed to customer vpc".

sam: proposed simple precedence: if X-VPC-Endpoint present AND recognized -> route to VPC private pool. else if X-Workspace -> route to workspace. else fall back to token-derived workspace. fallback order: vpc -> workspace -> token.

kevin: beware: some enterprise customers relied on header-hint to override workspace for testing. changing order could break them. we need opt-in or a rollout.

neha: suggest a canary rollout flag: GATEWAY_VPC_FIRST_ROLLOUT=percentage. default off for now. emit telemetry for hits.

sam: pseudo: 
```
if (hasVPC && rolloutHit) {
  route(vpc_pool);
} else if (hasWorkspace) {
  route(workspace_pool);
} else {
  route(token_pool);
}
```

jules: +1 on telemetry. add event fields: routing_reason, pool_id, fallback_chain, is_canary. anonymize workspace ids in metrics.

marta: also need quota semantics: when we route to vpc pool we must apply vpc-specific quotas. if routing fails and we fallback to shared pool, the quota evaluation must reflect that fallback (don't double-count). add a quota_ejection_policy.

kevin: operational note: add integration test that exercises simultaneous presence of X-VPC-Endpoint and X-Workspace across routing tiers. include stale vpce token case.

neha: console toggle idea: allow support to force-route a session to a specific pool for repro, and record audit entry. toggles should be gated by perms.

dev-bot: deploy: canary-gateway/vpc-first rollout started at 10% in staging.

sam: i'll open PR that: (1) fixes header parse order, (2) adds GATEWAY_VPC_FIRST_ROLLOUT flag, (3) emits routing.* telemetry, (4) console request-inspector column.

marta: please include migration note for legacy customers in the PR and a short rollback plan.

kevin: also add unit tests for header scrub order and an integration test hitting vpce lookup service (mocked).

sam: noted. will assign to me + kevin. drafting changelog and console ticket now.

marta: thanks — assign to support-triage for FYI and runbook update. :thumbsup:

kevin: one more—add warning logs if both headers present and mismatch (ws != vpce.owner). that'll help find bad clients.

sam: good call. i'll add: `log.warn("conflicting-routing-hints", { workspace, vpce })`. keep PII out.

jules: and add a small dashboard card: ratio of vpc-hinted requests that actually routed to vpc vs fallback. helps track rollout quality.

neha: perfect. i'll own the telemetry dashboard PR.

sam: closing thread after PR created. thanks all.
